patch.value: Adopt authoritative completion-timestamp contract from pm-cli SDK

Replace the hand-rolled completed_at->closed_at->updated_at->created_at chain in src/generator.ts with resolveCompletionTimestamp from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk, bump the dependency to 2026.7.29, and thread the returned source/fallback provenance through release attribution so inferred (fallback) attributions are distinguishable from authoritative completed_at ones. Surface the provenance in the release-context/generation report. Keep rendered CHANGELOG.md byte-identical for already-correct items; preserve created_at as the final local fallback when the SDK returns no timestamp. Add tests for all three source values and the all-absent path plus inferred-vs-authoritative reporting. Update README/docs.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Baseline established: 193 tests pass, coverage 89.81% lines / 79.00% branches / 90.71% functions, thresholds met. Current hand-rolled chain at src/generator.ts:1537 itemTimestamp(): completed_at ?? closed_at ?? updated_at ?? created_at. SDK resolveCompletionTimestamp (verified on host @unbrained/pm-cli@2026.7.29) returns {timestamp, source, fallback} where source is completed_at|closed_at|updated_at and fallback=true for closed_at/updated_at. When all three absent, SDK returns {source:'updated_at', fallback:true} with NO timestamp field -- so created_at must remain the final local fallback to avoid regressing the no-timestamp path.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: The pm-cli SDK resolveCompletionTimestamp (lifecycle-completion.ts) chain is completed_at -> closed_at -> updated_at and returns {timestamp, source, fallback} where fallback is false ONLY for completed_at. When all three are absent the SDK returns {source:'updated_at', fallback:true} with NO timestamp property (its declared return type marks timestamp: string, a type/runtime gap). pm-changelog must keep created_at as the final local fallback so no item is unplaceable. The SDK input type requires updated_at: string but PmItem types it optional -- bridge with an unknown cast (no any) to a narrower all-optional input type.
